headline.title: Vertu wants executives to pay $6,880 for an AI agent — here’s how it actually performs
headline.summary: Vertu's luxury foldable smartphone, priced at $6,880, features an AI agent designed to enhance user experience through workflows, battery management, and security. The article evaluates the device's performance in these areas, providing insights into daily usage.

articles.title: Databricks hits $188B valuation, extending its run as AI’s favorite second act
articles.summary: Databricks has achieved a valuation of $188 billion as it positions itself as a leader in the AI sector, focusing on open weight AI models for coding. The company has also published research highlighting the cost savings associated with these models.

articles.title: Should we benchmark conceptual capabilities using judgment prediction tasks?
articles.summary: The article discusses the challenges of using subjective judgment prediction tasks to benchmark AI capabilities, suggesting that such tasks may not effectively measure AI performance. It proposes an alternative approach where AIs are explicitly instructed to predict specific individuals' judgments on complex issues, such as the likelihood of an AI takeover.

articles.title: Neil Rimer thinks the AI money is coming back out
articles.summary: Venture capitalist Neil Rimer, co-founder of Index Ventures, forecasts that the significant wealth generated by AI in Silicon Valley will need to be redistributed, either voluntarily or involuntarily. His comments highlight the ongoing economic implications of AI advancements in the tech industry.

articles.title: The Zoom hack that says, ‘Don’t record me’
articles.summary: A recent article discusses the implications of automatic transcription and summarization of meetings and conversations, raising concerns about privacy and data usage. It highlights the need for clear boundaries regarding who has access to these records and how they are utilized.

articles.title: Agility Robotics plants its flag in Tesla’s backyard
articles.summary: Agility Robotics is establishing a new training center for its Digit robots in Fremont, California, positioning itself close to Tesla's headquarters. This facility aims to enhance the development and capabilities of its robotic technology.

articles.title: AI-driven memory crunch jolts India’s smartphone market
articles.summary: India's smartphone market is experiencing a slowdown as the rise of AI technology influences consumer preferences and corporate strategies. This shift is affecting pricing and demand dynamics within the industry.

articles.title: Apple’s plot to crush OpenAI
articles.summary: Apple has filed a lawsuit against OpenAI, raising allegations that many experts believe reflect standard industry practices. The motivations behind Apple's decision to publicly confront OpenAI remain unclear.

articles.title: How Apple’s big lawsuit could disrupt OpenAI’s IPO plans
articles.summary: Apple has filed a trade secrets lawsuit against OpenAI, alleging misconduct involving its chief hardware officer and claiming that over 400 former Apple employees are now at OpenAI. This legal action could potentially disrupt OpenAI's plans for an initial public offering (IPO).

articles.title: Patreon stops asking AI bots not to scrape — and starts blocking them
articles.summary: Patreon is enhancing its protection against AI scraping by collaborating with Cloudflare to block bots that unlawfully use creators' content for AI model training. This change signifies a transition from merely relying on robots.txt files to implementing more robust measures against unauthorized data collection.

articles.title: Why the first GPU financiers are turning to inference chips in a $400 million deal
articles.summary: A $400 million loan backed by chips signals a shift in focus from GPUs to inference chips among early GPU financiers, highlighting the evolving landscape of AI infrastructure. This deal underscores the growing demand for specialized hardware to support AI applications.

articles.title: Fine-tune video and image models at scale with NVIDIA NeMo Automodel and 🤗 Diffusers
articles.summary: NVIDIA has introduced NeMo Automodel, a tool designed to facilitate the fine-tuning of video and image models at scale, enhancing the efficiency of model training. This new offering integrates with Hugging Face's 🤗 Diffusers, enabling users to leverage advanced diffusion models for improved performance in visual tasks.
